description: The wording of one notification event on one channel. Subject and body are Jinja rendered against the event's context, so an administrator changes what people are told without a release.

fields.description: The event the application raises, for example policy.review.overdue. The application raises a fixed set of events; see Event Description and Available Context.
fields.label: Event

fields.description: One template per event and channel. Add a second template on another channel to send the event there as well.
fields.label: Channel

fields.description: An inactive template sends nothing on its channel. If no template for an event is active, the application's built-in wording is recorded instead, so the event is never silently lost.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Jinja. Rendered subjects longer than 140 characters are shortened.
fields.label: Subject

fields.description: Jinja. Plain text is sent with its line breaks kept; text containing HTML tags is sent as HTML.
fields.label: Body

fields.description: When the application raises this event and who receives it. Maintained by the application.
fields.label: Event Description

fields.description: The names a template may use. Every event also has recipient, recipient_name, subject_doctype, subject_name, link, today and doc (the subject record).
fields.label: Available Context

name: Notification Template
